kv1.9:1.3: Sabbe dhammā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati satibojjhaṅgo, ekāyanamaggo khayagāmī bodhagāmī apacayagāmī, anāsavā asaññojanīyā aganthanīyā anoghanīyā ayoganīyā anīvaraṇīyā aparāmaṭṭhā anuppādāniyā asaṃkilesikā, sabbe dhammā buddhānussati dhammānussati saṃghānussati sīlānussati cāgānussati devatānussati ānāpānasati maraṇānussati kāyagatāsati upasamānussatīti?
kv1.9:2.7: Cakkhāyatanaṃ sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati satibojjhaṅgo ekāyanamaggo khayagāmī bodhāgāmī apacayagāmī, anāsavaṃ asaññojanīyaṃ aganthanīyaṃ anoghanīyaṃ ayoganīyaṃ anīvaraṇīyaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ anupādāniyaṃ asaṃkilesikaṃ, cakkhāyatanaṃ buddhānussati dhammānussati saṃghānussati sīlānussati cāgānussati devatānussati ānāpānasati maraṇānussati kāyagatāsati upasamān ussatīti?
kv1.9:2.31: Anottappaṃ sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati satibojjhaṅgo ekāyanamaggo khayagāmī bodhagāmī apacayagāmī anāsavaṃ asaññojanīyaṃ aganthanīyaṃ anoghanīyaṃ ayoganīyaṃ anīvaraṇīyaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ anupādāniyaṃ asaṃkilesikaṃ, anottappaṃ buddhānussati dhammānussati saṃghānussati sīlānussati cāgānussati devatānussati ānāpānasati maraṇānussati kāyagatāsati upasamānussatīti?
kv1.9:3.9: phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, rāgo doso moho māno diṭṭhi vicikicchā thīnaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ
kv1.9:4.1: Cakkhāyatanaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ tañ ca na satīti?
kv1.9:4.3: Sati satipaṭṭhānā sā ca na satīti?
kv1.9:4.12: anottappaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ tañ ca na satīti?
kv1.9:4.14: Sati satipaṭṭhānā sā ca na satīti?
kv1.9:5.4: Nanu sabbe dhamme ārabbha sati santiṭṭhatīti?
kv1.9:5.6: Hañci sabbe dhamme ārabbha sati santiṭṭhati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv1.9:6.1: Sabbaṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha sati santiṭṭhatīti, sabbe dhammā satipaṭṭhānā ti?
kv1.9:6.3: Sabbaṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha phasso santiṭṭhatīti, sabbe dhammā phassapaṭṭhānā ti?
kv1.9:7.1: Sabbaṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha sati santiṭṭhatīti, sabbe dhammā satipaṭṭhānā ti?
kv1.9:7.6: cittaṃ santiṭṭhatīti, sabbe dhammā cittapaṭṭhānā ti?
kv1.9:8.3: Sabbe sattā upaṭṭhitasatino satiyā samannāgatā satiyā samohitā
kv1.9:9.4: "Amatan te Bhikkhave na paribhuñjanti ye kāyagataṃ satiṃ na paribhuñjanti,
kv1.9:9.5: amatan te Bhikkhave paribhuñjanti ye kāyagataṃ satiṃ paribhuñjantīti."
kv1.9:9.8: Sabbe sattā kāyagataṃ satiṃ paribhuñjanti paṭilabhanti āsevanti bhāventi bahulīkarontīti?
kv1.9:10.4: "Ekāyano ayaṃ Bhikkhave maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ aṭṭhaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ti."
kv1.9:11.4: "Rañño Bhikkhave Cakkavattissa pātubhāvā sattannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
kv1.9:11.6: Cakkaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, assaratanassa,
kv1.9:11.11: rañño Bhikkhave Cakkavattissa pātubhāvā imesaṃ sattannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
kv1.9:12.1: Tathāgatassa Bhikkhave pātubhāvā Aragato Sammāsambuddhassa sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
kv1.9:12.3: Satisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, viriyasambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, pītisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, passaddhisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, samādhisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti,
kv1.9:12.4: Tathāgatassa Bhikkhave Arahato Sammāsambuddhassa imesaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hotīti."
kv1.9:12.7: Tathāgatassa pātubhāvā sammāsambuddhassa sabbe dhammā satisambojjhaṅgaratanā va hontīti?
